scope: Three metadata models only. Hardware/runtime/ELF acceptance is separately recorded in REVIEW.md and review-receipt.json. No source-licensing conclusion is made.

compatibility.configurable_ccs: New required bool without serde(default). Active LSE inputs lacking it fail deserialization in both input models. Does not default unknowable hardware facts. Existing no-LSE chips remain unaffected.
compatibility.gpio_speed_offset: u32 becomes Option<u32> in all three models. JSON number 8 remains number 8. Missing/null deserialize to None and serialize as explicit null because no skip_serializing_if is present. Rust literals/accessors must change to Some(8)/None.
compatibility.output_routes: Existing Vec and static slice remain unchanged; empty list is representable. Exact F8U6 absence is source/package validation, not a new default.
compatibility.field_order: configurable_ccs is consistently inserted after maximum_hz. All other LseConfiguration fields remain in the same relative order and retain their types except gpio_speed_offset.
compatibility.unknown_fields: deny_unknown_fields remains on both deserializing LSE configuration records.
compatibility.static_generation: Derived Debug/stringify has no hand-written LSE field projection; bool and Option<u32> expressions match the static model. This is code inspection only, not compiled validation.
